title: Himachal Pradesh Tour Package
overview: Breathe in crisp cedar mountain air on this 6-day holiday. Drive through the historic Atal Tunnel into Lahaul’s Sissu waterfalls, soar on paragliders in Solang, and relax in scenic wooden chalets amidst apple orchards in Manali.
highlights: 3 Nights in Manali + 1 Night in Shimla + 1 Night in Kasol / Kullu
Drive through engineering wonder Atal Tunnel to Sissu, Lahaul Valley
Solang Valley adventure sports and snow activities
River rafting in Beas river, Kullu
Hadimba Temple, Vashisht Hot Springs & Old Manali cafes
inclusions: 5 Nights stay in handpicked 3★/4★ mountain resorts
Daily Breakfast & Dinner at all hotels
Dedicated private AC/Heated Sedan/Innova for entire tour
All toll, fuel, parking, and driver allowances
exclusions: Adventure activities fees (paragliding, rafting, quad bikes)
Rohtang Pass NGT green permit taxi if opted

itinerary.title: Delhi/Chandigarh to Shimla (Queen of Hills)
itinerary.description: Pickup from Delhi/Chandigarh and scenic highway drive through the Shivalik hills to Shimla. Check into hotel and stroll on the historic Mall Road and Ridge.
itinerary.eveningActivity: Walk along the Ridge, Christ Church and Mall Road

itinerary.title: Shimla to Manali via Kullu Valley & Pandoh Dam
itinerary.description: Drive from Shimla to Manali (approx. 7 hrs) along the Beas River. Stop at Pandoh Dam, Hanogi Mata temple, and Kullu Shawl weaving factory. Arrive in Manali by evening.
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Pandoh dam view & Kullu shawl factory visit
itinerary.eveningActivity: Check-in to Manali apple orchard resort & dinner
itinerary.stay: The Himalayan Resort / Apple Country Resort 4★, Manali

itinerary.title: Solang Valley Adventure & Atal Tunnel to Sissu Waterfall
itinerary.description: Head to Solang Valley for paragliding, zorbing, and ropeway. Cross through the 9.02 km Atal Tunnel to enter the dramatic trans-Himalayan landscape of Sissu in Lahaul Valley.
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Atal Tunnel drive to Sissu waterfall and snow points
itinerary.eveningActivity: Return to Manali for campfire and hot buffet
itinerary.stay: The Himalayan Resort / Apple Country Resort 4★, Manali

itinerary.title: Manali Local Sightseeing: Hadimba, Vashisht & Old Manali
itinerary.description: Visit the 500-year-old wooden Hadimba Devi Temple in deep cedar woods, holy Vashisht Hot Sulphur Springs, Club House, and cozy bohemian cafes of Old Manali.
itinerary.morningActivity: Hadimba Temple and Van Vihar pine forest walk
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Vashisht hot springs and Tibetan Monastery
itinerary.eveningActivity: Cafe hopping in Old Manali & wood-fired pizza
itinerary.stay: The Himalayan Resort / Apple Country Resort 4★, Manali

itinerary.title: Manali to Kasol Parvati Valley & Manikaran Sahib
itinerary.description: Drive to the scenic Parvati Valley. Visit Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara known for its natural hot springs and langar. Relax in the picturesque riverside village of Kasol.
itinerary.morningActivity: Drive to Parvati Valley with Kullu Beas river rafting
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara and hot spring dip
itinerary.eveningActivity: Riverside chill at Kasol and Israeli cuisine dinner
itinerary.stay: The River Crescent / Kasol Riverside Camp 4★

itinerary.title: Kasol to Chandigarh / Delhi Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast with river sounds before driving back to Chandigarh/Delhi airport or railway station.
